description:
**Dimension: msrv · 2 findings (1 medium, 1 low)** — see report §msrv. Criteria amended 2026-08-07.

- (med) `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml` — no `rust-version` field. Verified 2026-08-07: it is the only crate under `crates/` without one; the other five (`gf2-core`, `gf2-coding`, `gf2-algebra`, `gf2-sim`, `gf2-kernels-hip`) all declare `rust-version = "1.95"`. Without it `cargo check --locked` silently accepts older toolchains for this crate.
- (low) The AGENTS.md MSRV statement. The original finding asked for the sentence to enumerate the enforcing crates. That is superseded: `AGENTS.md:17` now reads "The Rust MSRV is 1.95. Use that toolchain for compatibility-sensitive work.", a blanket statement, and the documentation-overhaul epic caps that file at 200 lines. Make the blanket sentence true by pinning every crate rather than by maintaining a list that drifts whenever a crate is added.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml` declares `rust-version = "1.95"` in `[package]`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every crate under `crates/` declares `rust-version = "1.95"`, so the blanket AGENTS.md MSRV sentence is accurate without a per-crate list. No crate enumeration is added to AGENTS.md.
- [hard] REQ-03: `rustup run 1.95.0 cargo check -p gf2-kernels-simd` succeeds; fmt clean.
title: Pin MSRV 1.95 across all workspace crates
